system.description: A Focus for a relentless hunter who chooses, tracks, and defeats a quarry.

abilities.name: Hunter's Determination
abilities.description: Miss a foe to gain assets against that foe until the fight ends or you change targets.

abilities.name: Knowledge of Nature
abilities.description: Find food, water, and remedies in the wilderness when they are available.

abilities.name: Sneak Attack
abilities.description: Under a qualifying distraction or surprise, a light weapon attack deals 5 additional damage.

abilities.name: Fast Kill
abilities.description: Deal 4 additional damage on a melee or ranged hit, but not in consecutive rounds.

abilities.name: Quarry
abilities.description: Choose one visible quarry and gain an asset on tasks involving it.

abilities.name: Poison Crafter
abilities.description: Craft and handle poison effectively, including defenses against it.

abilities.name: Horde Fighting
abilities.description: When surrounded in melee, choose an asset to attack or defend against the group.

abilities.name: Awareness
abilities.description: Sense living creatures at long range until a recovery.

abilities.name: Better Sneak Attack
abilities.description: Sneak Attack gains an asset and can cause delayed Armor-ignoring damage.

abilities.name: Sprint and Grab
abilities.description: Move a short distance and grab a foe of your size or smaller.

abilities.name: Damage Dealer
abilities.description: Choose a weapon to deal 3 additional damage with it; this can be chosen twice.

abilities.name: Hunter's Drive
abilities.description: Double movement while reaching your quarry and gain another related asset.

abilities.name: Multiple Quarries
abilities.description: Quarry can target up to four visible creatures for an increased Intellect cost.

abilities.name: Lethal Strike
abilities.description: A successful swift weapon attack deals 7 additional damage.

abilities.name: Escape Plan
abilities.description: After killing a foe, attempt a stealth task as an extra action.
